description: Defines an abstract class NotesService, which outlines the interface for notes-related operations such as creating, listing, fetching, updating, and deleting notes in the application.

classes.name: NotesService
classes.description: An abstract class that specifies the interface for notes data operations, enabling different implementations (e.g., server API, mock data).

methods.name: abstract create(note: Pick<Note, 'title' | 'content'>): Observable<Note>; create
methods.description: Creates a new note with specified title and content.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all notes.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Fetches a note by its unique identifier.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing note identified by id with new title and/or content.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes a note from the collection by id.
